items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Lester was there during the period I was there -- I really enjoyed listening to Lester and playing for him, more or less.

ctx.x: On the inside. Am I wrong about Lester? Am I exaggerating? Am I putting too much emphasis on one element? Or did the peak come out at that time? What would you say?

Well, during the time that I was, you know -- Lester was there during the period I was there -- I really enjoyed listening to Lester and playing for him, more or less. I really did. And, he really made an impression on me, more or less, because of the fact he was different, and he swung like mad, and very early he was very melodic in his playing.
